WITH matched_telescopes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.observstation,
    t.bandusagepct,
    o.lunarstage
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    lunarstage,
    AVG(CAST(bandusagepct AS REAL)) AS station_avg
  FROM matched_telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation, lunarstage
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(lunarstage, 'Missing') AS phase,
    AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count
  FROM station_avgs
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM station_avgs
)
SELECT 
  phase,
  avg_bandwidth,
  station_count,
  CAST(station_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) AS fraction
FROM phase_stats
ORDER BY phase
